description: NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GB300 runtime acceptance spec for bring-up baseline on NVL72
_source: Calibrated from 2026-05-27 GB300/NVL72 bring-up measurements. Updated 2026-05-28 with PCIe placeholders (TBD after Phase B). Theoretical peaks live in GB300_specs.full.json.
_policy: Conservative sustained-performance thresholds for bring-up (~70-85% of theoretical peak). NOT to be confused with datasheet peaks.
_spec_selection_note: Binaries (bench_gemm/stream/nvbandwidth/all_reduce_perf) currently map GPU name 'NVIDIA GB300' to B300_specs.json via detect_spec_filename(). Keep B300_specs.json in sync with this file until binaries are rebuilt.
